records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/README.md
records.summary: Shantytown coordinates owned work for a crew through explicit capacity limits, tracker adapters, scheduled passes and recorded outcomes. Quipu integration remains optional.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/docs%2Fdesign.md
records.summary: Tracker and pane protocols separate work storage from session transport. Dispatch verification reads back delivery; refusal and dry-run outcomes preserve explicit uncertainty.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shantytown/shantytown%2Fcli.py
records.summary: The st console entry point provides work-item, crew, repository and scheduled-job commands. Anchor and roles show project governed role summaries; fleet-owner tend adds advisory priority ranking without reassignment. Failed responsibility reads remain UNKNOWN.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shantytown/shantytown%2Fconfig.py
records.summary: The configuration reader resolves shantytown.toml and declared environment settings. Local file-backed operation remains available independently of graph integration.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/docs%2Fintegrations.md
records.summary: Optional Quipu, Seeds, Bobbin and Yupana integration supplies shared registry, work tracking, context and structural policy through configured adapters.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/CONTRIBUTING.md
records.summary: The package keeps zero runtime dependencies and Python 3.11 as its compatibility floor. Existing source checks and the built console entry point must remain verifiable.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/README.md
records.summary: Start with the public overview and dry-run crew preview before configuring a tracker or launching sessions.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/docs%2Fconfiguration.md
records.summary: Review root discovery, backend selection and declared settings before changing deployment configuration. The ranking advisory supports a named board-metrics query and preserves UNKNOWN for incomplete coverage.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shantytown/CONTRIBUTING.md
records.summary: Use the contribution guide for supported Python versions, the zero-dependency constraint, test conventions and console-entry checks.
